cases.comparison: Allow and cache the first response, deny the second client, and serve the first client again from cache with exactly one upstream query.
cases.oracle: Independent UDP upstream logs requests; a separate source-bound client queries from 127.0.0.1 and 127.0.0.2 and checks DNS rcodes and exact A bytes.
cases.purpose: Client-IP RPZ policy applies even when another client has already populated the shared cache.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dns-rpz-cache-peer.py
cat > client-rpz.zone <<'EOF'
$ORIGIN rpz.local.
$TTL 60
@ IN SOA localhost. hostmaster.localhost. 1 3600 600 86400 60
@ IN NS localhost.
32.2.0.0.127.rpz-client-ip CNAME .
EOF
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve upstream.log & peer=$!
trap 'kill "$peer" "$res" 2>/dev/null; wait "$peer" "$res" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do [ -s upstream.log ] && break; sleep 0.05; done
[ -s upstream.log ] || exit 98
BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5347 dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5348 --upstream 127.0.0.2 --rpz "$PWD/client-rpz.zone" --max-queries 3 </dev/null 2>resolver.err & res=$!
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do
 ready=0
 while read -r slot local rest; do [[ $local == 0100007F:14E4 ]] && ready=1; done < /proc/net/udp
 [ "$ready" = 1 ] && break
 kill -0 "$res" 2>/dev/null || exit 98
 sleep 0.05
done
[ "$ready" = 1 ] || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" client upstream.log || exit 1
wait "$res" || exit 1
